later_review_audit.description: The original B tier should change to C for this snapshot. The source supports a user-confirmed electron-updater flow with same-channel sha512 metadata, but the Windows release configuration disables update code-signature verification. Therefore the recorded generalized OS signing trust-root statement is materially contradicted. C captures the observed application update channel without asserting that a release-wide signature policy is absent; the metadata checksum remains an integrity value whose trust source is not independently pinned.
